name: Nami Hokuto
source:
A promising first-year student in the tennis club.

She's a cute, quiet girl.
She's an exceptionally talented player, said to be a once-in-a-generation talent, but her
quiet personality has prevented her from achieving the results she desires.
Contrary to expectations, she had to withdraw
from a tournament due to injury... The pressure from those around her has only made her more withdrawn.

The protagonist, who knows of her past achievements as a player, is a respected coach.
The protagonist decides to take drastic measures to correct her personality...
